methodology: Editorial signals are based on dated, public evidence from the linked research sources. Labels describe the evidence available at the update time; they are not fabricated popularity scores.

signals.title: We're All Just Blocking the Street
signals.why: A Family Guy marching-band scene became a caption and lip-dub format. A September 15 remix passed one million views within six days.
signals.origin: Family Guy clip; meme breakout in September 2026

signals.title: Wawario and Wawaluigi
signals.why: Fan-made Mario opposites surged from late August into September after an original character song was reposted and remixed.

signals.title: Celebrity Lookalike / Star By Face
signals.why: Users are sharing celebrity-match reveals generated from their own photos. The format began spreading widely in early to mid-September.
signals.origin: Star By Face results shared on TikTok (September 2026)

signals.title: Thoughts on Lanterns
signals.why: Badly edited redraws turn the Lanterns cast into characters from other franchises. Several early variants received tens of thousands of likes.

signals.title: La Fairs
signals.why: A deliberately forced mash-up of two existing memes escaped its original stream; an early TikTok edit passed two million views in a week.
